run_text_to_image: run the WuerstchenCombinedPipeline to generate an image from a text prompt using from_pretrained
enable_cpu_offload: enable model CPU offload on the WuerstchenCombinedPipeline to reduce GPU memory usage
enable_sequential_cpu_offload: enable sequential CPU offload on the WuerstchenCombinedPipeline for maximum memory savings
enable_xformers_attention: enable xformers memory efficient attention on the WuerstchenCombinedPipeline decoder
configure_progress_bar: set the progress bar configuration for the WuerstchenCombinedPipeline prior and decoder pipes
